**On-call handoff — gateway 503s**

**Root cause:** Deploy `dep-4471` (gateway, a.novak, `2026-03-14T02:12Z`–`02:14Z`) shipped "connection-per-request for pool isolation," flipping config key `gateway.pool.perRequest` from `false` to `true` (generation 118 → 119, applied `02:13:41Z`). That change makes every request grab its own dedicated connection instead of sharing the pool, so the fixed pool of 20 fills up fast under normal load.

**Impact window:** First `503` at `02:14:18.972Z`, about 37 seconds after the config applied. Still ongoing at the end of the log, `03:59:27.974Z`, with the wait queue climbing (up to 74 waiting) — not self-healing. 548 total `503`s, 530 tagged `ERR_POOL_EXHAUSTED (size 20, in_use 20, ...)`. Hits `/v1/cart`, `/v1/session`, `/v1/checkout`, `/v1/orders`, `/v1/catalog/search` across all backend services.

**Roll back:** `dep-4471`. Revert `gateway.pool.perRequest` to `false` (the other two keys changed in that deploy, `upstreamMs` timeout and `log.sampleRate`, aren't implicated).

**Not affected:** Workers (`logs/worker.log`) ran clean through the same window, 1080/1080 jobs ok. One unrelated pre-existing slow-query warning (`OPS-2210`) at `02:36Z`, no connection to this incident.
